polls.description: Multiple violent attacks and assassination attempts have been made against OpenAI CEO Sam Altman by anti-AI extremists, raising security concerns for AI leaders.
polls.question: Should AI leaders get government security protection after these attacks?

cluster_stories.title: Man accused in Molotov cocktail attack of OpenAI CEO's home opposed AI, court documents say
cluster_stories.summary: Authorities allege Daniel Moreno-Gama threw the incendiary device about 4 a.m. Friday, setting an exterior gate at Altman's home alight before fleeing on foot, police said. Less than an hour later, Moreno-Gama allegedly went to OpenAI's headquarters and reportedly threatened to burn down the building.
cluster_stories.headline: MOLOTOV ATTACKER TARGETED ALTMAN... ANTI-AI EXTREMIST REVEALED

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI firebomber was trying to kill boss Sam Altman: prosecutors
cluster_stories.summary: A man who allegedly threw a Molotov cocktail at Sam Altman's luxury California home was trying to kill the boss of artificial intelligence giant OpenAI, US officials said Monday. Prosecutors say that after lobbing a firebomb at the gates of Altman's home, Moreno-Gama fled on foot to the San Francisco headquarters of OpenAI, where he tried to smash the glass doors of the building with a chair.
cluster_stories.headline: FIREBOMBER TRIED TO KILL SAM ALTMAN... ASSASSINATION PLOT REVEALED

cluster_stories.title: Man faces attempted murder charges in attack on home of OpenAI's Sam Altman
cluster_stories.summary: The Texas man, who also faces federal felony charges, allegedly had documents advocating for violence against AI executives.
cluster_stories.headline: TEXAS MAN FACES ATTEMPTED MURDER... ANTI-AI HIT LIST FOUND
